name: Moira MacLeod
bio:
Moira's journey into motorsport catering was somewhat accidental. After years running a small bakery in her hometown, she saw an opportunity to provide a higher standard of cuisine at local racing events. Her attention to detail and insistence on fresh, local ingredients quickly made her a favourite among teams and spectators alike. 

Now, Moira is eager to bring her culinary skills and organizational prowess to a larger stage. She believes that even in the fast-paced world of motorsport, a comforting, well-prepared meal can make all the difference to team morale and performance. Her ambition is to elevate trackside catering beyond the standard fare, providing nutritious and delicious options for everyone involved. 

 Moira's distinctive approach lies in her commitment to sustainable practices and her personal touch. She makes a point of getting to know the teams she caters for, tailoring menus to their specific dietary needs and preferences. This dedication, combined with her no-nonsense Scottish charm, ensures a loyal following wherever she goes.

physical.description: Moira is a stout woman with a warm smile and kind eyes.

quirks: Insists on using only Scottish butter, even when abroad.
Always carries a small tin of shortbread in her apron pocket.
Uses baking as stress relief, resulting in elaborate desserts after tense races.
